page.layout: One page of text, full width. Running head at top with page number at top right. Numbered theses in the upper part, then a rule, then the division heading and the text in two sizes. Signature at foot centre.

main_text.p: iv. Num credat homo demum postquam est justificatus, & fides justificationem sequatur? Neg.

v. Annon dolere & pœnitere de commissis peccatis, ex intuitu etiam transgressæ legis, & pœnæ demeritæ, indeque humiliari animo oporteat, ut quis se promissionibus Christi soletur, earumque faciat securum? Aff.
vi. Annon fidelibus & regenitis quoque lex moralis prædicanda sit? Aff.
main_text.head: Liber Undecimus De GRÆCIS, & ORIENTALIBUS.

p.i: GRÆCA Ecclesiæ olim præstantissimæ & celeberrimæ. Historia dissensionum, & controversiarum inter Græcos, ac Latinos. Origo illarum, & progressus. Ecclesiarum Scisma, vel secessio. Unio aliquoties tentata. De Concilio Nicæno, & canone ejus vi. super primatu episcopi Romani. Unde prima & gravissima quæstio Græcorum cum Latinis. De Concilio Constantinopolitano, ejusque can. iii, & symbolo. De Ephesino, contra Nestorium. Hinc de Nestorianismo, & quæstione quæ Græcas Ecclesias vehementer concussit, altera. De Chalcedonensi Concilio, & Eutychianismo. De Constantinopol. ii. contra Theodor. Mopsvestenum &c. De Monothelitis, & Conc. Constantinopolitano iii. vel trinisexto. De Concilio Constantinopolitano quinisexto habito in Trullo, variisque eo contentis controversiarum capitibus: de monogamia Clericorum; Canon xxxvi. de paritate Constantinopolitani episcopi cum Romano, de jejunio sabbathi, de esu sanguinis

page.notes: The heading "Liber Undecimus / DE / GRÆCIS, & ORIENTALIBUS." is set in several sizes; it is one heading. The large initial G is joined to "Græca". The mark at the lower right of the foot is not clear and is not transcribed. The last line of the page is a full line, not a catchword. Some letters in the italic text are damaged, and the reading "Mopsvestenum" follows the scan.
